Guarda i dischi lombari: quale livello è: Look at the lumbar discs: which level is abnormal and how do you describe it?
Nella RM lombare si legge un livello all:
On lumbar MRI you read one level at a time: disc height, nuclear signal on T2, posterior margin, endplates and the adjacent bone marrow, canal and foramina.
A healthy disc has a bright nucleus on T2. With degeneration it loses water and becomes dark and lower: the Pfirrmann scale goes from 1 (normal) to 5 (collapsed, black disc).
A diffuse bulge and a herniation are not the same thing: a bulge involves more than 25% of the disc circumference, a herniation is a localised displacement of disc material (protrusion or extrusion). The side of the herniation and its relation to the nerve roots are seen on axial images, which this collection does not include.
Herniations are common in people without pain too: the finding matters if it matches the symptoms (for example sciatica in the territory of the compressed root).
Conta i livelli dal sacro, poi guarda og: Count the levels from the sacrum, then check each disc: height, T2 signal, posterior margin.
Gradazioni del radiologo muscoloscheletr: Grading by the SPIDER collection musculoskeletal radiologist: L4-L5 herniation, disc narrowing, Pfirrmann 4; L5-S1 mild diffuse bulge, Pfirrmann 2; upper levels Pfirrmann 2, no changes.
T2 sagittale mediana: disco L4-L5 scuro: Midline sagittal T2: dark, narrowed L4-L5 disc with a posterior herniation
Come si individua il livello?: How do you identify the level?

Si contano i dischi dal sacro verso l'al: Count the discs from the sacrum upwards: the abnormal disc is the second one, L4-L5
Nelle sagittali lombari si parte dal sac: On lumbar sagittal images you start from the sacrum (S1, the first fused vertebra) and count upwards. With a lumbosacral transitional vertebra the count must be confirmed with the ribs or with thoracic spine images: lumbar sagittals alone are not enough.
Si contano i dischi dall'alto partendo d: Count the discs from the top, starting from the first disc visible in the image
Il primo disco in alto dipende da dove è: The top disc depends on where the field of view is centred: it may be T11-T12 or T12-L1. The reliable landmark is the sacrum.
Discopatia degenerativa L4-L5 con ernia: Degenerative L4-L5 disc disease with a posterior disc herniation; the other levels are preserved
Spondilodiscite L4-L5: serve un esame co: L4-L5 spondylodiscitis: an urgent contrast-enhanced study is needed
Nella spondilodiscite i piatti vertebral: In spondylodiscitis the endplates are eroded and the adjacent bodies show oedema (dark on T1, bright on T2); here the endplates are sharp and the bone signal is normal.
